entries.2415ae1cd525a78d: Environmental Living Space and Engineering Division
entries.29c940dde45d8ebb: This division manufactures and sells solar cell modules using solar cell module manufacturing technology, and manufactures, installs and sells film-laminated glass for heat insulation and scattering prevention used in house and building windows. Using machinery manufacturing technology, it also operates a factory automation integrator business, manufactures and sells equipment for semiconductor and liquid crystal applications, designs, builds and sells photovoltaic power generation systems, and undertakes logistics contracting. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥3,033 million. The consolidated subsidiaries Fujipre Hanbai Co., Ltd. and Prematech Co., Ltd. belong to this division.

entries.7ed75461d694eff0: Precision Bonding and High-Function Composite Materials Division
entries.89025b4dabf95f43: This division manufactures and sells solar cell modules using solar cell module manufacturing technology, and manufactures, installs and sells film-laminated glass for heat insulation and scattering prevention used in house and building windows.
entries.b29034577c29367a: The group consists of the parent company, Follow Wind Co., Ltd. (holding 42.37% of voting rights and deemed the parent under the control criterion), three consolidated subsidiaries, three non-consolidated subsidiaries and one affiliate not accounted for under the equity method. This division uses precision bonding technology to manufacture and sell display components and touch-panel sensor substrates, and also manufactures automotive parts. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,081 million. The consolidated subsidiary Toyosha Seisakusho Co., Ltd. belongs to this division.
